name: Barossa Green / Barossa Precinct data infrastructure platform
notes: Official Barossa Green site describes a staged multi-utility Barossa Precinct with Tier III-aligned sovereign AI-ready data infrastructure, 15 MW data capacity targeted for 2027 and 100 MW by 2030; LinkedIn/event material describes an 86-acre renewable-powered data centre precinct in South Australia's Barossa region.

name: South Australian Government Glenside Data Centre
notes: ABC and DCD reported an electrical fire at the state government's Glenside data centre, described as hosting SA Health and other government systems. DPC contractor disclosure also referenced preparation of a strategy for exit of Glenside Data Centre, so current operating status is not confirmed.

name: DCI Adelaide 01 (ADL01) Kidman Park
notes: DCI lists Adelaide 01 as a Kidman Park data centre; Baxtel places it at 340 Findon Rd. Dgtl Infra reported ADL01 at 2.2 MW with plans to scale to 4.0 MW.

name: DCI Adelaide 02 (ADL02) Kidman Park
notes: DCI announced launch of its A$70m ADL02 at Kidman Park next to ADL01; the new 4 MW facility increased campus IT load to 5.4 MW.

name: 5G Networks Adelaide Data Centre
notes: 5G Networks' wholesale page and data-center directories list an Adelaide data centre at 340 Findon Road, Kidman Park; Data Center Map describes it as part of the DCI Adelaide 01 facility and colocation listings indicate about 1 MW power.

division: South Australia - Clare and Gilbert Valleys
